# ShenoInventory — Warehouse OS
> Aisle-accurate inventory · barcode-native operations. Built for the floor, not just the desk.

## About
ShenoInventory is a single-tenant warehouse management system. Products carry
barcodes and Aisle/Bay/Shelf locations; the dashboard reports net profit,
revenue, expenses and inventory valuation from a single ledger. Purchase
orders, damages, returns, customers, suppliers and role-based access are
covered. Access is sign-in gated (demo account available).

## How
Open https://inventory.shenodev.tech, sign in with the demo credentials shown
on the login screen, and use the sidebar:
- Dashboard — live KPIs: net profit, revenue, expenses, inventory valuation.
- Products — barcode-native catalog with location, stock, reservations, reorder points.
- Purchase Orders — order stock from suppliers, receive shipments.
- Damages — write-offs valued at cost; "Not damaged" reverses a write-off.
- Customers / Returns / Suppliers — directory data and goods returned to stock.
- Transactions — the financial ledger behind every dashboard number.
- Users & Roles — admin/manager/operator/viewer access management.
